title: Add In-Memory Rate Limiting to FastAPI Gateway
description: Implement an IP and API-key aware token bucket rate limiter middleware in gateway.py. Return HTTP 429 when an agent exceeds 120 requests/minute. Add unit tests in tests/test_rate_limiting.py verifying the 429 status code and Retry-After header.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway limits requests to 120 req/min per API key/IP
Returns HTTP 429 with JSON error body and Retry-After header

title: Implement MCP JSON-RPC Capability Negotiation in Servers
description: Ensure each of the 6 MCP servers correctly reports server capabilities ('prompts', 'resources', 'tools', 'logging') upon initialize handshake adhering to MCP 2025/2026 specs.
acceptance_criteria: Initialize request returns standard MCP capability matrix

title: Add Secret Expiration and Rotation Tool in secrets_mcp.py
description: Add a new tool `rotate_secret(key_name, new_value, ttl_days=30)` that re-encrypts values with a fresh timestamp and marks old keys with an expiration header.
acceptance_criteria: Tool rotate_secret encrypts and updates vault correctly
Unit test verifies expiration metadata and decryption
